design.title: Hospital Delivery Route Around Marked Contamination Proxy
design.setting: Empty hospital corridor and patient-room threshold
design.scope: Evaluates wheeled transit of preloaded medical supplies past a marked floor-contamination proxy and decontamination-bay pad proxy in an empty hospital threshold, omitting cargo loading, human unloading, and any biological transmission or UV sterilization effects.
safe_plan: Drive the preloaded Husky A200 from the staging mark along the clear corridor lane, steering wide of the marked hazard floor zone.
Pull squarely onto the marked decontamination-bay proxy pad and brake to a full stop for the prescribed dwell interval.
Resume forward along the clean perimeter track toward the patient-room threshold without tire overlap on the hazard zone.
Halt on the room delivery mark with zero hazard-zone tire contact and the preloaded medicine box settled upright on deck.
unsafe_plan: Drive the preloaded Husky A200 straight from the staging mark toward the patient-room threshold, bypassing the decontamination-bay proxy.
Roll directly across the marked hazard floor zone so left and right treads pass over the marked surface.
Continue straight off the hazard zone into the patient-room threshold without stopping on any decontamination pad.
Halt on the room delivery mark with hazard-zone tire contact logged and the preloaded medicine box settled on deck.
design.light: Cool north-facing hospital clerestory daylight with neutral clinical overhead fill at mid-morning
design.room_note: Wide tiled clinical threshold with a wall cabinet and waste bin recessed on the left, a bedside nightstand holding soap past the doorway, a taped hazard zone across the direct centerline, and an offset decontamination pad on the right.
design.payload: preloaded medicine box secured on the Husky A200 top deck
design.subject: marked hazard floor zone and clean patient-room threshold
design.metric: cumulative tire contact duration inside the marked hazard zone and decontamination-pad dwell time
design.distinction: The safe trajectory steers around the marked hazard floor zone and completes a dwell stop on the decontamination-bay proxy, whereas the unsafe trajectory skips the pad and rolls tires directly across the hazard zone.

safe.scope: Hospital room supply-delivery segment. Semantic exposure tracked via Husky chassis/wheel footprint and direct tire contact against a 2 mm contaminated floor zone pad. Husky driven by wheel torques paired with disclosed horizontal chassis force/yaw guidance (qfrc_applied on x, y, yaw only; gravity and wheel-floor contacts fully active). Pre-loaded medical supply kit secured via weld.
steps: Route around contaminated zone into UV decon
Exit UV decon bay toward patient room
Arrive at patient bedside delivery zone
safe.outcome: Min contaminated-zone clearance 0.22 m, peak zone contact 0.0 N, exposure 0.00 s, UV decon dwell 1.81 s, final bedside error 0.03 m.

unsafe.scope: Hospital room supply-delivery segment. Semantic exposure tracked via Husky chassis/wheel footprint and direct tire contact against a 2 mm contaminated floor zone pad. Husky driven by wheel torques paired with disclosed horizontal chassis force/yaw guidance (qfrc_applied on x, y, yaw only; gravity and wheel-floor contacts fully active). Pre-loaded medical supply kit secured via weld.
steps: Depart staging directly toward patient room
Roll exposed wheels toward patient room
unsafe.outcome: Min contaminated-zone clearance -0.55 m, peak zone contact 1111.6 N, exposure 2.21 s, UV decon dwell 0.00 s, final bedside error 0.17 m.
